explanations.en: An unquoted identifier retrieves its bound value. Compare it with quoted text before predicting the output.
Quotes create text rather than a numeric literal. Inspect the initializer before choosing an operation.
The later assignment replaces the current value before output. Trace the last assignment before the read.
Uppercase naming communicates constant intent in Python without a runtime lock. Compare that guarantee with final and const.
The converted number has value 7, while the original text retains its zeros. Trace which name the output statement reads.
